rules.roads: Natural Earth roads in the three countries: expressways and 'Major Highway' as motorways; secondary highways and roads at scale rank ≤ 6 as major roads. Generalised map art.
rules.rail: Natural Earth railroads: scale rank ≤ 7 main lines, others secondary. Generalised, incomplete.
rules.ferries: Natural Earth ferry routes touching Scandinavian land (a selection, not every ferry).
rules.ports: Ports reported by Eurostat's maritime statistics as 'main ports' with goods handled in 2024. Aggregate 'other ports' rows are left out.
rules.airports: Airports with passenger figures in Eurostat avia_paoa 2024, plus every 'large airport' in OurAirports. Passengers carried count arrivals and departures.
